the earlier the menopause is, the more severe the sexual problems are and that the earlier the woman, the more pervasive the sexual consequences are.

1) sexual symptoms are common in premature menopause; 2) the earlier the menopause onset, the more severe sexual symptoms are; 3) sexual symptoms are more prevalent in women with a previous infertility history; 4) the earlier the infertility onset, the more prevalent the sexual symptoms are; and 5) sexual symptoms are associated with a lower sexual self‐image and a lower sexual quality of life.
